description: For my research thesis, I worked on developing a control and learning framework for enabling a robot to perform changing-contact manipulation tasks, using different machine learning (RL, SL, Deep) techniques and robot dynamics/control strategies. Read thesis.
Covered courses in Intelligent Robotics, Robot Kinematics, Dynamics & Control, Machine Learning, Neural Computation and Computer Vision.

Covered subjects including Mechatronics, Computer-Aided-Designing (Mechanical), Creativity and Product Development, Machine Tools, Fluid Mechanics, IC Engines, Design of Machine Elements, Thermal Engineering, and Mechanics of Machinery.
